summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hubs where models are stored, versioned, and shared) and developer-facing inference platforms (APIs that serve open-weight models on demand). As of 2026, Hugging Face anchors the ecosystem with over 3 million public models (surpassing 3 million in August 2026), though download distribution is highly concentrated—roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. Inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow, and Ollama have proliferated to make serving these open models fast, cheap, and accessible to developers without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open-source hub for hosting, discovering, versioning, and sharing machine learning models, datasets, and demo applications (Spaces), plus a serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public repos and limited serverless inference; Pro at ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and dedicated GPU compute billed hourly by instance; Enterprise Hub for organizations with per-seat pricing
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces repository
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Download stats and community collaboration tools
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers who want the broadest selection of open models/datasets and tooling for sharing, experimentation, and deployment

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool for running open large language models locally on personal machines (Mac, Windows, Linux) with a simple CLI and local API server.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (plus community/custom GGUF imports)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no API cost since models run on your own hardware
features: One-command local model download and run
Optimized GGUF quantized models for consumer hardware
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI format
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or cost-free experimentation

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models (especially image, video, audio, and LLMs) via a simple API, with easy packaging of custom models using Cog.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models across modalities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use, billed by compute time (per second of GPU/CPU runtime); pricing varies by hardware tier
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
Automatic scaling and no infrastructure management
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting fast API access to multimodal open models, especially generative image/video, without managing GPUs

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, offering fast, scalable serverless and dedicated endpoints.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (priced by model size); dedicated GPU instances billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per token processed
features: Broad catalog of leading open LLMs
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises building production LLM applications on open models who need speed, scale, and competitive token pricing

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A fast, production-grade inference platform for open-weight LLMs, vision, and audio models, emphasizing low latency and high throughput with its optimized serving stack.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference (by model); on-demand and reserved GPU deployments billed by usage/hour; fine-tuning available
features: Function calling and structured output support
platforms.best_for: Developers and companies needing the fastest, most cost-efficient production inference for popular open LLMs at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-focused inference cloud (with strong presence in the Asian market) serving a wide range of open-source LLM, image, audio, and video models through a unified API.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, FLUX, Llama, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token / pay-per-use pricing, often competitive; free credits for new users; some free-tier models
features: Strong support for leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen)
platforms.best_for: Developers (particularly in Asia) seeking affordable, fast access to Chinese and global open models via a single API

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform powered by custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware, serving popular open models at exceptionally high token-generation speeds.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, Gemma, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, priced by model; free developer tier with rate limits
features: Industry-leading inference speed via LPU hardware
Curated selection of top open LLMs
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications (chatbots, agents) that benefit from extremely fast open-model inference

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway/aggregator that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers, letting developers access hundreds of models through one endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing (provider rates plus small fee); no subscription required; automatic routing to cheapest/fastest provider
features: Single API for many open and closed models
Automatic provider failover and price/latency routing
Supports both open-weight and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to a wide range of models with simple unified billing and routing
